QuestInfo.name: The Missing Instructor
QuestInfo.0: It seems that the Resistance lost contact with #p2151000#, the Blaster Instructor during his latest mission, but that's all you know... Talk to #b#p2151003##k to learn more.
QuestInfo.1:
You are told that #p2151000# lost contact while he was on a mission to find out about the new Black Wings weapon being developed. Although there is no doubt that he infiltrated the Laboratory, there is no way to know what happened next. Fortunately, you have a lock on #p2151000#'s signal. Find and enter the hidden Laboratory entrance in #b#m310060220##k.

* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: You found #p2151000# inside the Laboratory prison. He's injured and immobile, but thankfully still conscious...

0.0: We got word that the mad scientist #p2154009# was creating a new weapon for the Black Wings. #p2151000#'s mission was to investigate that weapon.
0.1: I know for sure that #p2151000# was able to enter the Mine by disguising himself as a Black Wing. He even made it into the Laboratory where the new weapon is being developed. But we lost all contact with him shortly after that.
0.2: We never thought someone as skilled as #p2151000# could vanish the way he did... We can't sit here and do nothing! We must find him. That's where you come in...

yes.0: I won't lie to you. This mission won't be easy. It could even cost you your very life... But I think you're our best bet at saving #p2151000#.
yes.1: This #t4032740# will allow you to return directly to our Underground Base in the blink of an eye. It's valuable because we don't have many or hand them out often, but this is an emergency. Find #p2151000# and use this to return to us.
yes.2: Like #p2151000#, you should #bdisguise yourself as a Black Wing to enter the Mine and approach #p2154009##k to find out which lab the weapon's being developed in. Once there, you should be able to track down #p2151000#... Good luck!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I understand your fear. If even #p2151000#, your own job instructor, couldn't finish the mission... But I have confidence in you! You've got to reconsider.

1.0: I must be dreaming to think I'd see a friendly face in a cesspit like this. Someone pinch me and wake me up. \r\n(You shrug and pinch him.) \r\nOuch! #h0#? Is it really you? I have never been so glad to see you in my life!

npc.0:
Haven't you gone to the mine to find #p2151000# yet? I can explain it again if you're confused about the plan. 

#b* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
